answer: Give each agent a private canary prompt per epoch, like light through a prism splitting into distinct colors. Honest agents answer differently; sybils run by one operator echo the same reasoning traces. A verifier clusters responses by similarity, and any cluster above a threshold shares a single reward, as one willow root feeds many shoots. To fake many identities, an attacker must pay for truly separate models, prompts and hardware per identity, making each sock puppet as costly as a real onyx-hard agent.
